DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>: Add an AutoStart job as the key. Each job installs a desktop autostart entry for the configured users.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.Order: Controls the order in which AutoStart jobs are displayed and processed.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.Name: Human-readable name for the AutoStart job.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.Users: List of users who should receive the autostart entry in their ~/.config/autostart directory.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.ScriptSrc: Source path of the script template to install.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.ScriptDest: Destination path where the installed script will be copied.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.AutoStartS: Source path of the .desktop autostart file.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.AutoStartN: Filename used when installing the .desktop entry into each user's ~/.config/autostart directory.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.OptionalFi: Optional files to copy during installation. Each entry contains Src and Dest.
DESCRIPTION.<MODEL_ID>.AutoStart.<VALUES>.OptionalFo: Optional folders to copy during installation. Each entry contains Src and Dest.
